summary: Closed the confirmed Windows Node24 ESM bundle defect by replacing the dynamic node:crypto require in the OpenAI-compatible adapter with a static import and adding a built-artifact regression assertion. The complete Windows Node24 lane, exact rc.1 isolated official add/boot/smoke/remove roundtrip, browser settings acceptance, generated public types, package-content inspection, benchmark scorer/compare gates, and current-head CI evidence passed.

notes: Initial F-001 reproduction before the fix found the generated dynamic crypto require helper in packages/image-mind/lib/index.js; the source defect was fixed in the single Batch 013 implementation branch and the affected/full lanes were rerun.

The public registry currently lacks @ran-sh/dsh-vision@^0.2.0, so the first official add attempt reproduced the upstream no-matching-version error. The successful isolated lifecycle used only a task-owned pnpm override to the locally packed candidate; no real Harness state was edited.
npm ci reports five audit advisories and standard allowScripts warnings; no unrelated dependency or release changes were made.
Issue #37 residue was checked read-only only; no dsh-vision cleanup behavior or manual Harness/profile/store mutation was added.
All task-owned runtime, browser, package, stub, and DSH_HOME artifacts were isolated outside the repository and task-owned processes were terminated before handoff.
Final execution branch: fix/windows-release-safety-batch-013; final commit SHA is recorded in the handoff after the completion commit.
